text: 山西前三季度GDP增长0.5%，连续4个月煤炭减产超3成 山西要“在严守安全底线前提下，全力推动复工复产、稳产稳供，加速扭转产量下滑趋势，加快重塑山西煤炭产业生态。”
text_en: Shanxi's GDP grew 0.5% in the first three quarters, with coal output cuts exceeding 30% for four consecutive months; Shanxi vows to "fully promote resumption of work and production and stable output and supply under the premise of strictly observing the safety bottom line, accelerate the reversal of the output decline, and speed up the reshaping of Shanxi's coal industry ecosystem."
